resources.string: Dish is free and open source.
Donate to keep it that way →
Dish runs on coffee and goodwill.
Dish, Satellite, and every Dish client are free, open source, ad-free, and analytics-free. No paywalled features, no upsells, and no plans for any of that. Donations are what keep them true.

Monthly sponsorship, processed by GitHub. Lowest fees, no platform cut. The most stable way to support Dish month after month, and the only one that GitHub matches dollar-for-dollar through the GitHub Sponsors Matching Fund where eligible.
Tip jar. Buy us a coffee, no account required. Ko-fi takes no cut on one-time tips, so every dollar reaches the project.
Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal
Quick one-time gift or a monthly membership. Card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay. Great if you don\'t have a GitHub account.
Hosting. dish.tinkernorth.com, tinkernorth.com, and every signed-installer mirror. AWS isn\'t free, even at our traffic scale.
Code-signing certificates. Windows SmartScreen only plays nice because we pay for an EV certificate every year. The same goes for the Apple Developer Program account for the upcoming macOS client.
Google Play developer fee. A one-time $25 fee plus the time required to keep the Play listing compliant with every new policy round.
Time. Honest answer: most of it. Dish is a nights-and-weekends project. Donations let me say \"yes\" to working on it instead of taking on extra consulting.
Thank you. Every dollar, every star, every shared link. They all add up. Emir
Donate via GitHub Sponsors, Ko-fi, or Buy Me a Coffee.
